messages:
Aisha: Quick sync for CloudForge marketplace onboarding. Need Day0 owners: credentials, legal artifacts, hero SKU packaging. Goal: submit to AWS/GCP/Azure next Tue.

Tom: Ill own the legal package and localization bits. Need CloudForge SOC/PCI evidence and their tax ID. @Priya do we want a trial SKU or time-limited trial?

Priya: Product recommends hero SKU + 14-day developer trial. Pricing tiers: dev(trial) / standard / enterprise. I'll draft listing copy, include 3 screenshots and a short Redwood blurb. ETA by EOD tomorrow.

Carlos: For engineering validation we need partner staging account, AMI/container images, manifest, and a service account/role. Suggest validation regions: us-west-2 and europe-west1. Also need to map plans to meter IDs.

Jen: I can provision staging offers. Carlos, paste the minimal IAM policy you want and Ill apply it to the staging role. Also confirm telemetry: ensure no PII is forwarded to partner logs.

marketplace-bot: :information_source: Publish checklist: artifacts, images, legal package, pricing, trial SKU, billing meter IDs, contact emails. Missing: AWS billing meter ID.

Aisha: Tom, verify EU EULA localization needs and VAT handling with finance. Also we need hero logo: PNG 1024x1024 + SVG.

Tom: Noted. I'll request partner tax docs and logo usage form. Legal prefers wording: use "customer-managed deployment" instead of "private deployment."

Priya: Packaging note: include optional section "Deploy with Redwood Private" but dont gate trial on it. Azure needs explicit entitlement mapping for trial plan  Carlos can you map that?

Carlos: Will map plans to meters. Staging IAM snippet (read-only) we intend to use:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [ { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["ec2:Describe*"], "Resource": "*" } ]
}
```

Jen: Creating staging offers now with that policy. Will ping when accounts are ready.

Aisha: Recap actions: Tom -> legal package & partner tax docs; Priya -> listing copy + screenshots; Carlos -> meter-ID mapping & manifests; Jen -> staging accounts; Aisha -> collect partner assets. Target: Monday EOD prep, submit Tue morning. :calendar: 

Priya: Looping in marketing for one-liner and screenshots.

Tom: Partner asked to use our logo in co-marketing; legal needs signed logo usage form. @Aisha can you request it?

marketplace-bot: :white_check_mark: Checklist update: missing assets now: logo usage form, AWS billing meter ID, Azure entitlement mapping.

Aisha: I'll chase partner today and update thread if anything blocks. Thanks all!
